name: Hungarian Down
description: Clusters of ethically sourced Hungarian goose down. Plush, cloud-like, and naturally warming — ideal for side sleepers with broad shoulders.

name: Memory Foam Contour
description: Contoured memory foam that cradles the neck and supports the cervical spine. Hypoallergenic and CertiPUR-US certified.

name: Shredded Latex
description: Shredded natural latex with an adjustable fill level. Open-cell structure sleeps cooler than memory foam. GOLS certified organic.

name: Buckwheat Hull
description: Thousands of natural buckwheat hulls that conform to your head shape and allow air to circulate freely. Adjustable loft. A traditional favourite in Japan.

name: Slim Down Pillow
description: A slim, flat pillow designed to keep stomach sleepers' necks neutral and prevent arching. Lightweight Hungarian down fill.
